findings.entity: green olives poured from small glass container into large jar
findings.description: The small glass cup held at the top of the jar contains only bright green olives, but as the olives drop into the large glass jar between 00:00 and 00:03, many of them arrive at the bottom of the jar as dark purple/black olives.

findings.entity: second batch of green olives poured from small glass container into large jar
